video_title: "They Like Bron Ain't LeBron" - Boogie Cousins UNLOADS on Lakers

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins criticizes how the Lakers treated LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I don't like the way he was treated in LA.
quotes.quote: I don't like the way he was treated in LA. We are in this era now that you cannot really speak on his behalf or it is considered, 'Oh yeah, he is paid by Clutch,' all this goofy shit. But for the most part, I grew up in the era of watching LeBron. He created the blueprint for the next guys coming up. I think he is a legend in this game, hands down. I don't think they are going out gracefully the way they should. From Melo to how CP was handled, we are watching how the Lakers act like Bron ain't LeBron. I want to go wherever he is going to be appreciated and where he is going to get the flowers he deserves.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson defends LeBron James's legacy against ring-chasing narratives
quotes.excerpt: People forget that Shaq left Penny, left Orlando and went to LA.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: People forget that Shaq left Penny, left Orlando and went to LA. You are going to leave the small market to go to the big market? And then all of a sudden Phil Jackson magically appears. Phil Jackson jumped ship and was like, 'You know what? I am going to jump over here because I see these studs.' So now they went three championships. For people to say that it was chasing rings and LeBron left the original team that he was drafted, people forget that Grant Hill and T-Mac teamed up in Orlando. And if not for Doc Rivers fucking it up, Tim Duncan would have been there.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: Tim Duncan was on the way. That is true.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: This is true. Tim Duncan is like my big brother. I love him to death. I remember asking him a question and he goes, 'Once Doc Rivers literally said, look, we are going to get it done with or without you.' And Tim was like, 'Excuse me?' The fact that Tim Duncan, Grant Hill and T-Mac, and if not for Grant Hill's ankle injury, Grant Hill was a top-five player in the league when he left Detroit to go to Orlando. And T-Mac left Toronto. They were literally doing a big three in 2003.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson argues LeBron James's Lakers tenure was highly successful
quotes.excerpt: Go back and compare his eight years with Shay's eight years.
quotes.quote: Go back and compare his eight years with Shaq's eight years. Go back and compare his eight years with Jokic's eight years. One conference finals, one championship. Obviously, he was one of the higher vote-getters for MVP, but he didn't qualify. But if you go look at the success he had during his tenure with LA, it is on par with Shaq's years. Shaq is going to get a statue in OKC. It is on par with Jokic. But somehow in LA, people are like, they glad that he is gone. Did you all forget what it looked like before he got there? It was boo-boo.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the clash between Kobe and LeBron fanbases
quotes.excerpt: There are Laker fans and then there are Kobe fans. There are LeBron fans and then there are Laker fans.
quotes.quote: God rest Kobe's soul. A lot of people did it like on the heels of Kobe's passing and LeBron, they did not want that spotlight shared in LA. There are Laker fans and then there are Kobe fans. There are LeBron fans and then there are Laker fans. And that is where the clash in my opinion. The Kobe fans wanted nothing to do with Bron being in LA wearing that purple and gold because Kobe was their guy. Laker fans were like, 'Hey.' But people were miserable the whole time because there was a comparison to Kobe and that part they missed out on so much good basketball.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson questions Luka Doncic's path to respect in LA
quotes.excerpt: What does Luka honestly have to do to get respect in LA?
quotes.quote: What does Luka honestly have to do to get respect in LA? Because is he going to get the same treatment as Bron? It is different, Bron. No, it is not even about Luka. I understand, but it is now because Luka. Brother, that is what you got to work with. And guess what? Utah is going to get better, Minnesota is better.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson predicts Western Conference team improvements
quotes.excerpt: OKC is going to come back, now they got three gigantos.
quotes.quote: OKC is going to come back, now they got three gigantos. Then you got Minnesota, then you got San Antonio, Houston is come back for Fred VanVleet. I think Phoenix will be a good team. I don't 50-50 on the Clippers, no offense to the Kings. What I am saying is the Lakers, what does Luka have to do to get respect in LA? Because is he going to get the same treatment as Bron?

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the volatility of Lakers fan expectations
quotes.excerpt: If you have a bad stretch, they turn on you quick.
quotes.quote: If you have a bad stretch, they turn on you quick. And like I said, I am not comparing Luka to these guys, but I don't think he will ever have a bad stretch as far as numbers-wise or anything like that. I think he is just a natural-born scorer. But as far as delivering the ultimate prize, which is championships in LA, that is their standard, which is deservedly so. I just feel if he does come short, I think we are going to see another side of that fan base.
